RB-16 · Sound Library

Kits & grooves.

Everything here is synthesized on the fly — no audio files anywhere. Tap a voice to hear it, or hit a groove to loop it right in the page. Open the machine to program your own.

Drum voices

Ten voices, each built from oscillators and filtered noise. Tap to audition them on the bright 909 kit.

Factory kits

Each kit re-tunes every voice. The same beat sounds completely different across kits — that's the point of a drum machine.

Factory grooves

Press a groove to loop it in the browser. Each loops with its own tempo, swing and kit. Press again to stop.

Make your own

Pick a kit, tweak the voices, draw a beat across sixteen steps and chain patterns into a song — all in the browser, all synthesized live.
